Scripts.OnClick: if C_Item then MI2_SlashParse(this:GetName(), false) end

Scripts.OnValueChanged: if C_Item then MI2_SlashParse(this:GetName().." "..math.floor(this:GetValue()), false) local valTxtFrame = getglobal( this:GetName().."ValueText" ) valTxtFrame:SetText( tostring(math.floor(this:GetValue())) ) end

Scripts.OnLoad: if C_Item then UIDropDownMenu_SetWidth( 120 ) getglobal(this:GetName().."Title"):SetText( MI2_OPTIONS[this:GetName()].text ) UIDropDownMenu_Initialize( this, MI2_DropDown_Initialize ) MI2_OPTIONS[this:GetName()].dd = 1 end

Scripts.OnTextChanged: if C_Item then MI2_SlashParse(this:GetName().." "..this:GetText(), false) end
